headline: The listing says 2108 Orange. A Labor Day post still said 2053.
summary: This is a real family homestead at 2108 Orange Avenue in Ramona. The Beene family already shows up in the story. Facebook still prints cbeene32@gmail.com and (760) 814-4836. The live shop is lilpatchofheaven.org, a cart with a wellness blog. Google Maps is live tonight at 2108 Orange Ave, 4.8 stars from about 31 reviews, every day 8 to 8. A Labor Day Facebook post still shows up in search with 2053 Orange Ave, open from 8 to 8. Leftover cards still point at cbeene32.wixsite.com/lilpatchofheaven. That Wix door is still a 404 tonight. A neighbor with an honor-system run can pull up to the wrong Orange Avenue number, or land on a leftover Wix door that is gone.

signals.note: You show up for a Ramona homestead and farmstand. Google Maps is live tonight at 4.8 stars from about 31 reviews. Facebook is alive. A neighbor looking for pasture eggs, meat, or the honor-system fridge can find you.
